description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.295 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Stock price for up to 5 US equity tickers in one call — returns current stock price, change %, volume, day range, and 52-week range per ticker. Works with any NYSE/NASDAQ symbol (STRC, AMD, MSTR, SLV, USO, etc.). Sourced from Yahoo Finance public data, no API key.
